answer: Make each account keep its own sequential delay chain alive. Every epoch the ledger posts a fresh random pulse; the account folds it into a verifiable delay function needing about an hour of single-core squaring and submits the proof before payout. Squaring cannot be parallelised inside one chain, so a farm of a thousand fakes needs a thousand cores busy all day, while validators check each proof at the inlet in milliseconds. Like a juniper hedge, standing must be grown continuously: a chain that misses a deadline stops earning.
